trap.label: to a large extent
trap.wrong: I agree in a large extent.
trap.right: I agree to a large extent.
trap.why: O brasileiro usa “em grande medida” → in. Em inglês: to a large/limited extent.

mcq.q: To what extent do you agree? Answer:
opts: To a large extent, I agree.
In a large extent, I agree.

fix.wrong: I agree in a large extent.
fix.right: I agree to a large extent.

fix.wrong: To a limit extent, I agree.
fix.right: To a limited extent, I agree.

rewrite.prompt: Use to a large extent: “I mostly agree.”
rewrite.answer: I agree to a large extent.

rewrite.prompt: Use to a limited extent: “I partly agree.”
rewrite.answer: I agree to a limited extent.

rewrite.prompt: Use to some extent: “I partially agree.”
